source.title: Liquidity risk and expected cryptocurrency returns

hypothesis: Higher lagged Amihud illiquidity predicts higher subsequent weekly cryptocurrency returns.
universe: Each Monday 00:00 UTC, eligible Binance USD-M USDT perpetuals with complete lagged feature history; retain top 100 by lagged trailing-30-day quote volume before illiquidity sorting. No future-survival filter.
feature: Mean over prior completed W days of abs(close-to-close daily return) / daily quote volume; W in {14,30,60}, canonical 30d.
portfolio: Equal-weight long highest-Amihud quintile and short lowest-Amihud quintile, 0.5 gross each side.
rebalance: Weekly Monday 00:00 UTC at current open using data through prior completed UTC day.
development_gate: Canonical mean weekly rank IC >0.02, positive top-minus-bottom return, canonical net Sharpe >0.70, and at least 2/3 windows positive.
success_gate: Canonical OOS net Sharpe >1.0, positive at 2x costs, >=2/3 windows positive, both years non-negative, max drawdown <35%, excluding BTC/ETH and strongest-asset removal positive.
notes: Top-100 lagged quote-volume screen is fixed ex ante to avoid relying on economically untradeable micro-contracts.
